facts.meaning: Local cached promise records the ballot accepted by preparation or initialization and is consulted to qualify acceptance traffic.
facts.validity_context: Successful storage operations within this object; initialization reloads backend promise.
facts.durability: Written through Storage.set_promise; actual persistence depends on backend.
facts.recovery: Stored promise causes Recover initialization and PrepareReq exchange.

facts.meaning: Installed snapshot is paired with a compacted index and represents the prefix exposed through snapshot reads; content preservation during delta synchronization is unresolved.
facts.validity_context: After successful log synchronization with snapshot data; local compaction is an additional establishment path not yet mapped.
facts.durability: Snapshot and compaction metadata are written through atomic storage operations.
facts.recovery: Cache reloads compacted index and read obtains backend snapshot.

facts.meaning: An actor pending invocation has an assigned log index and ballot recorded for its EntryId; this records assignment, not that the same content remains at that index after authority changes.
facts.validity_context: While Pending remains in actor memory; assignment can arrive locally, from a matched Assigned reply or deferred batch reconciliation.
facts.durability: Volatile actor state; not persisted in the consensus log.
facts.recovery: No pending-call restoration is established; handle channel closure resolves Shutdown.

surfaces.reason: Delta base boundary relationship is sourced in b_sync; fixed execution and attribution remain in the snapshot Candidate and its review.
Buffered reconfiguration continuation differs from buffered ordinary proposals.
Assignment and notifier completion paths mapped; subscriptions and backpressure remain separate open mechanisms.
Cross-configuration routing contract must be traced before evaluating missing local checks.
Snapshot/Trimmed entries compress several logical indices but subscriber cursor increments by one; trace delivery boundaries separately.

formation.explanation: Append is buffered during Prepare or accepted in Leader/Accept. Promises are indexed by sender and a prepare quorum selects highest accepted-round/length history. The leader synchronizes that history before accepting pending work and sends AcceptSync. Followers persist synchronized or incremental entries, reply Accepted after flush, and leader counts per-node accepted indexes against write quorum. A successful threshold advances decided index and propagates Decide or piggybacked decisions. Reads expose only the decided suffix through the direct API.

context.explanation: BLE uses heartbeat rounds, connectivity and ballots to suggest leadership; manual takeover also increments a ballot. SequencePaxos independently requires a newer promise, resets leader accounting, and gathers a prepare quorum. Prepare changes follower promise/phase and sequence context. Old ballot traffic is rejected or answered NotAccepted; a sequence gap causes recovery. Restart with persisted promise enters Recover and asks peers to prepare; same-ballot recovery is permitted. StopSign is transferred with accepted history and seals ordinary append admission once accepted; the caller activates the next configuration only after decision.

connection.explanation: A new ballot does not discard established history: promises report accepted round/index and decided index, the selected history is synchronized, then follower support can qualify new formation. Leader accounting is fresh on takeover while prior decisions constrain transferred prefixes. Pending normal proposals are consumed on leader preparation or forwarded after follower AcceptSync; buffered StopSign uses a distinct path that still needs lifecycle investigation. Snapshot synchronization is the supporting history mechanism whose output later becomes decided content visible to applications.

open_details: Buffered StopSign is not forwarded by forward_buffered_proposals; determine caller completion contract and alternative paths.
Runtime completion uses assigned position before ballot invalidation; investigate replacement decided before drain.
Concrete persistent backend and configuration routing remain unread.
